product.description: Monoprice™Multi‑Functional Recessed Connected Media Box (Without Power)Streamlined In‑Wall Solution for Organized Media Device and Cable ManagementThe Multi‑Functional Recessed Connected Media Box (Without Power) provides a clean, organized, and secure in‑wall solution for managing TV connections, media devices, and structured wiring. Built with versatility in mind, this recessed media box is ideal for installations behind flat‑panel TVs, entertainment centers, and connected home systems where a streamlined appearance and reliable cable management are essential.Featuring included mounting brackets, the Recessed Connected Media Box securely holds the Samsung® One Connect Box or other compact TV power sources, ensuring that your components remain firmly in place. To further enhance stability, the kit includes two 30‑inch hook‑and‑loop fasteners that allow you to strap equipment tightly to the brackets. This eliminates the risk of shifting components and provides a dependable mounting environment for sensitive electronics.For connectivity and expansion, this media box includes two large knockouts for easy USB access, allowing direct connection of accessories without removing the device. Multiple knockouts are also provided for conduit up to 2 inches in diameter, ensuring maximum flexibility when routing HDMI®, Ethernet, coaxial, and other low‑voltage cabling. Additionally, the design features knockouts for a single‑gang J‑box power module, allowing integrators to adapt to a wide range of installation requirements.The box's standard 1" x 6" hole pattern ensures compatibility with commonly used mounting accessories, while its ability to mount either to the front or inside of wall studs allows it to adapt to various construction scenarios. Once installed, the box sits flush with the wall, creating a discreet, low‑profile solution that blends seamlessly into residential or commercial environments.Engineered for both performance and safety, the Recessed Connected Media Box includes an open trim ring that promotes airflow, preventing heat buildup and extending the life of connected components. This thoughtful feature makes it especially well‑suited for high‑demand entertainment systems or connected smart home hubs.Whether you're a professional installer or a DIY enthusiast, the Recessed Connected Media Box makes organizing and concealing cables, power modules, and media devices easier than ever. With its durable construction, flexible knockout system, and integrated mounting solutions, it delivers a professional‑grade finish that elevates any installation. The Recessed Connected Media Box is the ideal choice for anyone seeking a reliable, adaptable, and clutter‑free media management solution without compromising on accessibility or style.Secure Mounting
